title: THE WRONG TIDE
logSummary: The Gauge followed through one tide to the bronze post it levels to, and Benchmark 2 made true.

stages.note: Rest at your Brazier till the tide turns; follow the Gauge
stages.log: Followed the Gauge out across the pans on the turn.

stages.note: Find the mark the Gauge levels to
stages.log: Found Benchmark 2, a bronze post standing in the Glass.

stages.note: Watch the Gauge go back to Sluice 3
stages.log: The Gauge walked back to the Pan Houses' clock.

stages.note: Have the Reckoner rung made at the guild house
stages.log: The guild made the Brine-Cured: salt and three scutes.

closing.note: The pans flood on the right tide
closing.logEnd: The Gauge keeps our tide again. Benchmark 2 is a node.

scenes.where: the guild house, the tide board

lines: The pans flooded at the wrong hour
walks off on its own tide now.
Out and back takes it ten minutes.
Then walk behind it. Find what
it's reading, and make it read us.
Rest at my Brazier till it turns,
then out behind it. One tide.

breaAlone.about: Brea's own turns in the field on 'The Wrong Tide': one card each, shown as a subtitle when its trigger first happens. Each trigger shows once.

lines: Benchmark 2. A bronze post a metre
The pans can read the post again.
Back on Sluice 3, on the hour.
Three float scutes the Gauge shed,
and forty salt. That's the rung.
